name: Hole Swallow
tagline: Start small. Finish with a skyline.
description: Steer a hungry hole through a shared city. Swallow props to grow, then cars, houses and towers. Bigger holes can swallow smaller rivals, but everyone comes back. Most points after 90 seconds wins.
howToPlay: Drag the pad on your phone to move your numbered hole. Release to stop.
Swallow objects that fit inside your rim to grow. Start with bins and trees.
Bigger holes can swallow smaller holes. You return after three seconds and keep your points. Most points at 90 seconds wins.
